title: Snap logic silently no-ops for SymbolInstances and TextDisplayObjects
description: All four snap modes (snap-to-guides, snap-to-grid, snap-to-objects, snap-to-pixels) in StageArea.tsx use shapeDisplayObjects.find(o => o.id === drag.shapeId) to get the dragged object's bounds. When dragging a SymbolInstance or TextDisplayObject, the find() returns undefined and snap is silently skipped. Fix: change the lookup to search ALL display objects (shapes + instances + text + bitmaps), not just shapes. The lookup is at StageArea.tsx lines 2964, 3012, 3022, 3038.
